ROPC is removed in OAuth 2.1 and prohibited under FAPI — the app handles the raw password, must ship a client secret to authenticate itself, and has nowhere to put a second factor. Configure the service for authorization-code + PKCE instead; the generator then emits the system-browser flow and the app stops seeing the password at all.
